title: 10 Small Ways a Godly Man Serves Without Being Asked
caption:
10 small ways a godly man serves without being asked.

Leadership starts on the boring Tuesday, with the dishes nobody else picked up. Christ came to serve, and He hands men like us the same job.

Pick two of these this week.

#faith #service #godlymen #christianman #leadership #manofgod
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
